dedupe_keys.name: kinematic collapse load calculator for circular arches

description: The Kinematic Collapse Load Calculator is a MATLAB GUI for upper-bound limit analysis of ideal semicircular masonry arches. Its contributors publish the calculator source and interface file in the SoftwareX code archive. Users enter arch geometry, admissible hinge positions and either an asymmetric point load or constant horizontal acceleration. The model calculates a collapse load multiplier, hinge reactions and a thrust line. Coverage is one specified arch, not a mapped building or bridge network. Its static analysis has no time step or period. The publisher code metadata states an MIT licence for version 1, and the code is freely accessible; the GitHub mirror does not display a root licence file. The model could support screening of masonry arches in buildings or transport structures under the specified loads. A limitation is its ideal semicircular geometry and chosen hinge mechanism, which may not represent an actual asset or dynamic earthquake response. No related catalogue record was identified. No structure was analysed and the MATLAB code was not run.
inputs: Semicircular masonry-arch geometry and hinge configuration
Asymmetric point load or horizontal acceleration
name: Kinematic Collapse Load Calculator for Circular Arches
notes: G5 G5-0966. The own GitHub mirror has no root licence file or classifier; MIT comes from the article code metadata for v1. The paper describes an educational ideal semicircular arch, not a verified bridge or building assessment. MATLAB was not run.
